Contributions are welcome.
Open an issue or a pull request on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-extensions-updater), and use [Discussions](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-extensions-updater/discussions) for questions.

## Development

```bash
npm install     # Install dependencies
npm run build   # Build the action
npm test        # Run tests
npm run format  # Format code
npm run lint    # Lint code
npm run all     # Format, lint, and build
```

The action runs from `dist/index.js`, which is built from `src/` with `ncc` and committed to the repository, so `npm run build` must be run before opening a pull request that touches `src/`.

## Documentation

This website lives in `docs/` and is a Quarto project using the [`atelier`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-atelier) project type.

```bash
quarto preview docs   # Preview locally
quarto render docs    # Render to docs/_site
```

The [inputs and outputs](reference/action.qmd) tables are generated from `action.yml` by `docs/assets/filters/action-reference.lua`, so adding an input to the action is enough for it to appear in the documentation.

## Related projects

- [Quarto Wizard](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard): a Visual Studio Code extension for managing Quarto extensions.
- [Quarto Extensions](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-extensions): the registry of Quarto extensions this action reads.
